text: Level three, question six: A and B start at the same time towards each other; after meeting, A takes sixteen hours and B nine hours to reach their destinations; find the ratio of their speeds, and B's speed if A's is forty-five kilometres per hour. Question seven: a policeman spots a thief two hundred metres ahead; the thief runs at ten kilometres per hour and the policeman at twelve; how far does the thief run before he is caught? Question eight: two cars start at the same time from towns A and B towards each other at fifty and forty kilometres per hour; when they meet, one has covered sixty kilometres more than the other; find the distance A B.
